LanguageData.RT_BT5_Vehicle.label: BT-5 Fast Tank
LanguageData.RT_BT5_Vehicle.description:
Soviet high-speed light cavalry tank capable of high road speeds, armed with a 45mm 20-K gun.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Commander/Gunner x1, Loader x1 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 45mm 20-K Cannon: 45x310mmR (AP / Canister) - 7.62mm DT MG: 7.62x54mmR cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP)
